summary: Frontend testing of Ordem de Serviço (OS) Valores Adicionais with new Quantidade (Qtd) field. All UI calculations and edit-load persistence verified successfully via Playwright on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

test_results.create_modal_qtd_field: PASS - new Qtd input (data-testid input-valor-extra-qtd-{idx}) appears with default value 1 when adding a row via btn-add-valor-extra
test_results.live_subtotal_per_item: PASS - Subtotal for item 0 (Qtd=2, Valor=R$ 5.500,00) shows R$ 11.000,00 (valor-extra-subtotal-0). Subtotal for item 1 (Qtd=3, Valor=R$ 1.500,00) shows R$ 4.500,00 (valor-extra-subtotal-1)
test_results.auto_computed_total_os: PASS - os-valor-total-calc shows R$ 15.500,00 (11.000 + 4.500) when no discount; updates to R$ 15.000,00 with R$ 500 discount entered in input-valor-desconto (formula: sum(valor*qtd) - desconto)
test_results.edit_load_preserves_quantidade: PASS - Created OS via API with quantidade=[2,3], reopened via edit pencil in list. Modal showed Qtd 0='2' and Qtd 1='3' (NOT reset to 1), subtotals R$ 11.000,00 and R$ 4.500,00, total R$ 15.500,00
test_results.list_view_total: PASS - OS row in list shows valor_total R$ 15.500,00 (e.g. OS-21 Test OS with quantidades visible after creation)
test_results.pdf_export_button: PASS (UI present) - btn-export-os-{id} exists; backend endpoint /api/admin/ordens-servico/{id}/export-pdf reachable. Backend PDF rendering already validated per E1 (subtotals 11.000/4.500, total 15.500)

critical_code_review_comments: OrdensServicoPage.jsx is 1573 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting OS form, list, filters, and export logic into smaller modules for maintainability.
Qtd onBlur snaps empty/<=0 values back to 1 (line 1136-1142) which is correct UX; handleSubmit also defensively coerces quantidade>0 (line 403). Good defense-in-depth.
MoneyInput uses cents-based mask (digits/100). Edit-load passes numeric value via useEffect sync, correctly displays existing R$ 5.500,00 on reopen.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one temporary OS via API (TEST_QTD_PRESERVE) to validate edit-load behavior; cleanup DELETE returned 200. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend OS Qtd feature fully working: live subtotal per row, auto-computed Valor Total (sum(valor*qtd) - desconto), edit-load preserves quantidade. OS route is /administrativo/ordens-servico (not /ordens-servico). Login flow: /login -> /select-system -> direct goto OS URL. Token stored in localStorage as 'token'. PDF endpoint is /api/admin/ordens-servico/{id}/export-pdf (NOT /pdf).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Feature implementation verified end-to-end in frontend.
